hard_spots.why_hard: Long loose sentence with dropped subjects; unclear who tells vs hears, where they are, when this is, whether past/present/future or dead/old. English must keep it grammatically unfixed and still going on (smile continues, no one moves) and must not name the three or turn あの日 into heaven.

Oddly literal bad mouthful: expected sweet-soft, found as-if-frozen hard and ざくざく gritty/crunchy, profoundly 無味 tasteless, unrelated/cold. She re-bites with front teeth. Do not symbolise or prettify; keep disproportion between small cause and far-away heart it gives her.

Narrator says baby girl and uses 彼女 for her, yet both parents call her 坊や (little boy / generic baby). She/her and they/them pronouns are reused for mother, child, parents, and vision trio. Fixing to boy or girl breaks text; needs consistent house solution with note.

あの日 / その日, 安息 vs 安らかさ: ordinary rest or eternal rest? Old age looking back, approach of death, or both on purpose? Husband's もう少しの間だ and wife's 働きませうね are practical and smaller than vision. Do not harmonise into shared hope or religious consolation.

Short exchanges with minimal tags, slight non-sequitur (why silent? -> only three years since marriage), repetition of three-year count in three keys, mixed polite/plain registers. Also historical kana, ruby glosses (テーブル, れいり, ほゝゑみ), and dropped subjects throughout p8-p10 that require mapping without clarifying away.

ledger.rationale: Frame word. Three plain appearances must stay verbally linked and bare: opening perception, wife quietly re-hearing it inside vision, husband whispering it at end. Not a symbol to underline.
Source writes 卓 with ruby テーブル; physical anchor of disorder and warmth. Keep one English word throughout so clearing/ drumming/ feeding/ clearing-up read as same object.
ledger.source: 卓《テーブル》 / テーブル

ledger.rationale: Period interior: single dim bulb hanging over table in narrow room. Keep dim/dark, not modern bright lighting.
White steaming just-cooked rice served from pot; father crams it into own mouth between feeds. Keep warm staple vs cold potato contrast.

motifs.english: Keep one English adjective/adverb throughout: far / far away / from afar. Do not vary to distant/remote.
motifs.motif: far / far-away heart, far picture, far future
motifs.why: Spatialises her detachment: taste gives her a far-away heart; memories and vision are seen from far off. Network must survive.

motifs.english: Keep quiet/still (not calm/peaceful which belong to 安らかさ). E.g. quiet, quietly.
motifs.why: Chord with far and smile; marks both interior state and unmoving vision figures and final room after child sleeps.

motifs.english: Keep smile (noun/verb) for 微笑・笑み・笑ひ・笑ふ across table, vision, and return. Do not vary to grin/laugh except where child cries out (叫声).
motifs.why: Thin thread linking laughing parents, unmoving vision figures who only go on smiling, and wife's solitary returning smile. Varying breaks identity.

motifs.english: Keep tiredness / exhausted / weary; keep sleepy/drowsy for まどろむ/打沈んだ, not same as tired.

motifs.why: Opening physical description (his hollow gentle eyes, her hair/shoulders) returns as moral weight; husband's dialogue echoes it as daily wearing-down. Must read as same condition.

motifs.english: Keep the trio nostalgia and forgiveness and peace/rest together in same order where text conjoins them; do not paraphrase.
motifs.motif: nostalgia (懐かしみ) + forgiveness (許し) + peace/rest (安らかさ/安息)
motifs.why: Crux chord. Dreamlike suffering-become-nostalgic (p13) hardens into doctrine that all will change into nostalgia/forgiveness (p17, p20). Checker will look for exact recurrence.

motifs.english: Keep long / long-drawn / for so long. Repeat, do not elegant-vary.
motifs.motif: long story, long life, long grief/suffering
motifs.why: Vision's endless story (p16) returns as wife's private litany (p20). Repetition is incantation, not redundancy.

motifs.english: Keep only three years / just three years / still only three years with numeral spelled out; keep all three statements.
motifs.motif: only three years since marriage yet feels endless / already old

narration.english_tense: Past as default for narrated action (was/were, gathered, served), preserving present-like perception at frame edges (p1 storm as bare perception; p38 whispered constatation) and ongoing present-continuous for vision's still-going smile/telling (go on smiling, no one moves). Do not complete vision with past-summary.
narration.frame: Single evening supper in narrow room under dim bulb, storm outside. Opens on storm unadorned, middle forgets storm in noise (p8), wife re-hears it quietly inside vision (p19), closes on husband stopped whispering it after child sleeps and room quiets (p37-38). Nothing solved.
narration.narrator: Third-person external narrator, initially even between parents, then settling almost wholly inside wife via free indirect memory and vision; husband never given interior access beyond spoken words and contained smile
narration.tense_habits: Literary historical-kana mix: だ・であった copula for tableau, てゐた progressive for ongoing states, た past for acts, ている/する present-like for gnomic vision claims; subjects/objects freely dropped, speaker tags minimal; interior slides from 思出した to 見てゐた without marking dream vs seeing
timeline: one stormy evening: family gathers, clears grabbables under table, begins meal (p1-p9)
mouthful of gritty cold potato -> wife falls silent, remembers three poor frightened ill years as already dreamlike (p10-p14)

vision: dim light, three heads together telling endless story of all good/evil/joy/suffering, smiling motionless in nostalgia/forgiveness/rest; doctrine that life past will change into those (p15-p17)
return glance at scattered table, sigh, husband's first why silent? re-hearing of storm inside vision (p18-p19)
private resolve: long life/suffering after, yet that day exists; she smiles alone (p20)
dialogue counting years: only a little while / just three years yet troubles / still only three years + hope; baby will walk; baby fed (p21-p33)
parallel practical close: his almost-to-self it won't be much longer, her calm let us work, clear up, sleep, rise early; child asleep at breast, quiet room, whispered storm (p34-p38)

data.say: Bible holds frame, crux slippage, and open questions steady: keep storm plain and linked, potato literal, repetitions unvaried, vision unfixed, dialogue registers distinct, 坊や contradiction visible.

style_sheet.annotation_density: Casual: none except where теплопод kitchen term blocks sense; Curious: 3-4 notes max (Bōya, gohan/nimono, ansoku/yasurakasa, storm frame); Student: fuller glosses plus ruby and historical-kana note. Never note what context supplies.
style_sheet.author_voice: Warm crowded physical tableau thinning into loose incantatory interior: long additive sentences circling far/quiet/long/smile/nostalgia/forgiveness/rest; slight disproportion kept (small gritty potato opens vast distance); tenderness enacted not stated; no lyrical uplift beyond plain words
style_sheet.honorifics_and_names: No family or personal names in text. Keep kin/role terms as common nouns (father, mother, husband, child). No -san/-chan. Preserve 坊や problem per ledger; preserve あなた/お前 absence (couple never address by pronoun, only by silence-question and 坊や to child). Name order N/A.
style_sheet.keep_in_japanese: Casual: no Japanese except food words if needed in italics; Curious: keep Bōya, gohan, arashi on first use with note; Student: keep Bōya, gohan, jagaimo, arashi, ansoku/yasurakasa with readings. All views keep ruby sense in English (e.g. table).
style_sheet.quotation: Japanese 『』 for direct speech and 独言 mutter rendered as English double quotes; inner独言 within narration as quoted thought with same marks; babble うまうま as quoted sound. No single-quote nesting unless quote-within.
style_sheet.register: Narrative diction plain literary, slightly dated but readable; dialogue split: wife soft polite feminine です・ます・のね, husband blunt warm masculine plain だなァ・なんだな; child babble. Do not harmonise into one middle style or ennoble poverty.
style_sheet.ruby_and_italics: Ruby glosses inform reading: 卓《テーブル》 -> table (not desk); 怜悧《れいり》-> clever; 微笑《ほゝゑみ》 -> smile; 茫然《ぼんやり》 -> blankly. Italics only for kept Japanese terms (Curious/Student) and for babble umma-umma if kept as sound; never for emphasis the Japanese does not mark.
standing_rules: Do not clarify vision: no naming the three, no heaven/death/old-age decision, no past-tense completion; smile continues.
Do not vary deliberate repetitions: far, quiet, smile, long, nostalgia/forgiveness/peace, three years, storm.
Do not symbolise potato or storm; keep both literal and linked.
Do not let husband understand vision; keep dialogue non-sequitur and closing resolve practical and parallel, not shared.
Track彼女/彼等 by referent map; same pronoun covers mother, child, parents, vision trio — English must choose noun, not pronoun, where ambiguous.
